title: MAXYOYO Giant Bean Bag Chair Bed for Adults, Includes Two Beds (Pink, King)
amazon_match_notes: Exact ASIN B0GFTF974X matches MAXYOYO Giant Bean Bag Chair Bed for Adults, Includes Two Beds, Pink King two-piece set; Woot offer page data and brand listing title match.

comparisons.notes: Same title and description: two beds zip together, corduroy cover, Pink. Store SKU 2pice-pink matches Amazon MPN N-ANT-B01-Short-Pink-2pcs (2-piece pink). Single variant listed as available at $269.99 with no compare-at price.

writeup: Woot has the MAXYOYO Giant Bean Bag Chair Bed for Adults, a pink King set that includes two beds, for $75.99, new. The corduroy cover is machine washable, and the two foam pieces zip together from an oversized chair into a floor mattress the listing says sleeps four to five people. MAXYOYO's own site lists the matching two-piece pink set (store SKU 2pice-pink, MPN N-ANT-B01-Short-Pink-2pcs) in stock at $269.99, so this is about 71 percent below that price and saves about $194. Quantity is capped, with at least three left and a limit of three per customer.
